mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, manager_id, user_count, active_projects, completed_projects, created_at, updated_at FROM departments ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT id, name, description, manager_id, user_count, active_projects, completed_projects, created_at, updated_at FROM departments WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments (name, description, manager_id, user_count, active_projects, completed_projects, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{managerId}, #{userCount}, #{activeProjects}, #{completedProjects}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, full_name, department_id, role, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET user_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE department_id = #{departmentId}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{departmentId}
UPDATE departments SET active_projects = #{activeProjects}, completed_projects = #{completedProjects}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{departmentId}
